name: Fixed monthly allowance
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 and Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.5: a fixed allowance paid every month for work in normal time is wage, so it enters the SSO and WCF bases; employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1).

name: Benefit in kind (housing, car, employer-paid tax)
authority: Revenue Code ss.39, 40(1): income from employment includes money's worth and "other benefits" the employer provides — free housing, a car, and the income tax the employer pays for the employee. The monthly value (and for borne tax, the tax borne) enters the PND1 base without being paid; not SSO or WCF wage. The gross-up of a borne tax repeats by the next month's amount.
